tasks.label: Validate translation agents
tasks.command: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $python = if (Test-Path .env) { ((Get-Content .env | Where-Object { $_ -match '^PYTHON_EXECUTABLE=' } | Select-Object -First 1) -replace '^PYTHON_EXECUTABLE=', '') }; if (-not $python) { $python = '${command:python.interpreterPath}' }; & $python -m pytest -q; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & $python -m ruff check src\services\foundry_agents.py src\activities\check.py agents tests\test_foundry_agents.py

tasks.label: Create and smoke-test translation agents
tasks.command: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $env:PYTHONPATH = 'src'; Get-Content .env | ForEach-Object { if ($_ -match '^([A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*)=(.*)$') { Set-Item "env:$($Matches[1])" $Matches[2] } }; $python = if ($env:PYTHON_EXECUTABLE) { $env:PYTHON_EXECUTABLE } else { '${command:python.interpreterPath}' }; & $python agents\create_agents.py --write-env .agent-versions.env; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; Get-Content .agent-versions.env | ForEach-Object { $key, $value = $_ -split '=', 2; Set-Item "env:$key" $value }; & $python agents\smoke_test.py

tasks.label: Install Power Platform CLI
tasks.command: dotnet tool install --global Microsoft.PowerApps.CLI.Tool; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & (Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.dotnet\tools\pac.exe') help

tasks.label: Install Power Platform CLI Windows package
tasks.command: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $installer = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'powerapps-cli-install.msi'; Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://aka.ms/PowerAppsCLI' -OutFile $installer; $signature = Get-AuthenticodeSignature $installer; if ($signature.Status -ne 'Valid' -or $signature.SignerCertificate.Subject -notmatch 'O=Microsoft Corporation') { throw 'Installer signature validation failed' }; $process = Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList @('/i', ('"' + $installer + '"'), '/passive', '/norestart') -Wait -PassThru; if ($process.ExitCode -notin @(0,3010)) { throw "Installer exit code: $($process.ExitCode)" }; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $installer; $env:PATH = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('PATH','Machine') + ';' + [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('PATH','User'); pac help
